import json, sys, numpy as np
np.set_printoptions(linewidth=200, precision=6, suppress=False)
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work'); sys.path.insert(0,'/app/submission')
import gen as G, check as C
import planner as P
seed=int(sys.argv[1])
r=G.gen(seed)
req=P.parse_request(json.dumps(r).encode())
prob=P.Problem(req)
print("M,K,P,R,n", prob.M, prob.K, prob.P, prob.R, prob.n)
y,q=P.solve_infeasible(prob)
print("maxabs", np.max(np.abs(y)), np.max(np.abs(q)) if q.size else 0)
big=np.argsort(-np.abs(y))[:12]
print("big y idx", big, y[big])
print("q", q)
print("b", prob.b)
print("demand", prob.demand)
print("base", prob.base)
print("caps", prob.cap)
for k,c in enumerate(req["commodities"]):
    print(k, "s,t,d", c[0],c[1],c[2], "paths", c[3], "prev", c[4])
PYEOF
